# Commands console and shared Thunderbird memory system

For Thunderbird history, use `[local path]` and `origin/main`, not `origin/master`. Fetch Phabricator review history through `transaction.search` and `differential.getrevisioncomments`, save each result incrementally, and treat restricted/nonexistent revisions as coverage limits rather than evidence of no discussion. `../mach commlint` remains the documented lint entry point. [Task 3]

Scope: general.
